tasks.title: Voltage drop on a wire
tasks.statement: A copper wire with a cross-section of **{a} mm²**, length from the battery to the load **{l} m** (positive and negative — the same length back), current **{i} A**. Find the voltage drop across the pair of wires (V). ρ of copper = 0.0172 Ω·mm²/m.
tasks.solution: R = ρ·(2L)/A, ΔU = I·R. Out and back — the length doubles.

tasks.title: Wire heating
tasks.statement: A current of **{i} A** flows through a wire with a resistance of **{r} mΩ**. How many watts are dissipated?
tasks.solution: P = I²·R. Current is squared — doubling the current quadruples the heating.
